summary: Meta's FAISS project published its v1.15.0 release with a large set of new vector index types, GPU/cuVS backends, RaBitQ and quantization performance optimizations, hardened deserialization, and various bug fixes and renames.

practices.reason: The RaBitQ fastscan query path and related SIMD/kernel optimizations give a stated throughput gain that a team running FAISS-based vector search could apply directly.
practices.quote: Optimize RaBitQ fastscan query setup + 80% qps (#5396)

practices.reason: A quantizer type name change is a breaking API change that any team using the SQI8 identifier must update in their code.
practices.quote: Rename SQI8 to SQ8 to be consistent with the rest of Faiss (#5337)

practices.reason: New memory-mapped I/O support for Flat and Vamana SVS indices changes how large indexes could be loaded/served, worth evaluating for deployments with big index files.
practices.quote: Implement memory-mapped I/O for Flat and static Vamana SVS indices (#5271)
